svg.aria-label: Attack versus defense journey: a real visitor passes silently while a botnet flood is fingerprinted, scored, challenged, tarpitted and blocked before reaching the backend

g.text: How SonuShield stops an attack — without bothering real visitors
Two journeys through the same defenses · every layer below is a real, configurable feature · schematic, not to scale
The visitor notices nothing: the invisible cookie check passes silently, and the page simply loads.
The defense layers, in the order every request meets them
Read left to right, top row first · Layers 1–9 build suspicion · 10–11 enforce · 12–16 serve what passed
Blocked requests never reach the backend — and the owner watches it all live on the dashboard.
Schematic animation — packet speeds and timings are illustrative; layer order and thresholds match the real pipeline.
